Install Karne Ka Tareeqa

Sirf 4 step — 2 minute mein app tayyar. Har step bare harfon mein likha hai, ghabrana nahi.

  1. 1
    Download button dabayein
    Upar wala hara (parrot) button dabayein. Google Drive khule ga — wahan Download dabayein aur file poori download hone dein.
  2. 2
    Download ki hui file kholein
    Phone ke Downloads folder ya upar wali notification se file kholein. Agar file .zip ho to pehle Extract karein, andar wali .apk file kholein — zip install nahi hoti.
  3. 3
    “Allow from this source” — Allow karein
    Phone pooche ga ke is source se install karna hai ya nahi — ye bilkul normal hai kyun ke app Play Store se nahi aa rahi. Allow / Install dabayein. Play Protect warning aaye to Install anyway dabayein.
  4. 4
    App kholein — Demo khud shuru ho jaye ga
    Install ke baad WBBS kholein. 14 din ka FREE demo khud shuru ho jaye ga — abhi koi key nahi chahiye. Pasand aaye to baad mein key mile gi.

Aam Sawal

“App not installed” aaye to kya karun?

Pehle check karein ke file poori download hui hai aur aap .apk file khol rahe hain, .zip nahi. Agar phone mein pehle se koi purani test wali WBBS hai to use pehle uninstall karein, phir ye install karein — purana test data delete ho jaye ga.

Kya ye bilkul free hai?

Shuru ke 14 din demo bilkul free hai — saari cheezein try karein. Us ke baad chalane ke liye license key chahiye gi, jo Ghulam Ahmad & Son's se mile gi. Plan 1, 2, 3, 4 ya 5 saal ka hota hai.

Nayi version aaye to dobara kya karna hoga?

Kuch nahi — yehi page aur yehi link rahe ga. Bas is page par dobara aa kar download kar lein, naya version purane ke upar install ho jaye ga aur aapka data mehfooz rahe ga.

Madad chahiye to kis se rabta karun?

Jis number / WhatsApp se aap ko ye page mila hai, usi par message kar dein — Ghulam Ahmad & Son's ki team madad kar de gi. Screenshot bhej dein to masla jaldi samajh aa jata hai.

Owner Ke Liye — Drive Link Lagayein

Ye hissa sirf Ghulam Ahmad & Son's ke liye hai. Dukandar ko sirf upar wala hissa chahiye.

  1. APK ko Google Drive par upload karein.
  2. File par ••• → Share → “Anyone with the link” karein.
  3. Wo link copy kar ke neeche wale khane mein paste karein — Download button isi waqt chal jaye ga.
  4. Dukandar ko bhejne ke liye neeche bana hua suffix is page ke link ke akhir mein jod dein.
